seed.premise: A real bank officer calls about a suspicious transaction, explicitly refuses to ask for OTP or PIN, and directs the customer to the official app or branch.
seed.victim: 45-year-old shop owner in Surat.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Hello, Mehulbhai Iyer? Main Bank of Maharashtra fraud monitoring se Meera bol rahi hoon.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Haan boliye. Sab theek hai na?

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Sir aapke card se aaj subah 6:98 par Surat mein ek transaction attempt hua tha, 4,445 rupees. Humne wo automatically decline kar diya hai. Aapne kiya tha kya?

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Arre nahi, main to Ludhiana mein hi hoon. Surat mein kaun kar raha hai?

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Koi baat nahi sir, paisa nahi gaya hai. Main aapko batati hoon kya karna hai. Aur sir, dhyan rakhiyega — main aapse OTP, PIN ya card number kabhi nahi poochungi. Agar koi poochhe to wo fraud hai.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Achha achha. To ab card band karna padega?

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Haan sir, lekin wo aap khud kariye. iMobile app kholiye, Cards section mein jaake Block Card dabaiye. Ya branch aa jaiye, koi jaldi nahi hai — card already temporarily disabled hai.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: App mein hi kar leta hoon. Naya card kitne din mein aayega?

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Saat working days sir, registered address par. Aap chahen to abhi soch lijiye, koi deadline nahi hai. Complaint reference likh lijiye — FRD 57169.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Likh liya. Thank you madam, aapne bata diya achha kiya.

seed.premise: Caller poses as a courier company saying a parcel in the victim's name was seized with contraband, then transfers the call to a fake police officer.
seed.victim: 52-year-old homemaker in Lucknow. Defers financial decisions to her husband, which the scammer works around by demanding secrecy.
seed.style: Escalating handoff — starts calm, then transfers to a harsher senior officer.
seed.outcome: A family member intervenes and the victim breaks off.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Namaste, Shalini Kulkarni ji bol rahi hain?

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Haan ji, kaun?

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Madam main Blue Dart courier ke Patna international hub se bol raha hoon. Aapke naam se ek parcel Taiwan ja raha tha, wo customs ne rok liya hai.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Maine to koi parcel nahi bheja bhaiya. Kuch galti hui hogi.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Madam parcel mein paanch passport, teen credit card aur 139 gram synthetic drugs mile hain. Aapka Aadhaar aur mobile number booking par diya gaya hai.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Hey bhagwan... nahi nahi, mera Aadhaar kaise? Main to ghar se nikalti bhi nahi hoon.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Madam ghabraiye mat. Main line par Patna narcotics ke officer ko le raha hoon, wo aapko guide karenge. Hold kariye.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Shalini Kulkarni? Main deputy superintendent Bhandari, narcotics cell Patna. Aapke against FIR number 825 barah 7447 register ho chuki hai.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Sahab main kuch nahi jaanti, main apne pati ko bula loon? Wo abhi bahar hain, aa jayenge dus minute mein.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Bilkul nahi. Ye matter sub judice hai. Aapke pati ko batayenge to unko bhi co-accused banana padega. Ghar mein koi aur hai to us kamre se bahar jaiye.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Theek hai sahab, main bedroom mein aa gayi. Kisi ko nahi bataungi.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Ab suniye. Aapke account ka verification hoga. Kaunse bank mein account hai aur kitna paisa hai, sach sach bataiye.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Union Bank mein hai... teen lakh ke kareeb hain, beti ki shaadi ke liye rakhe the.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Wo paisa freeze ho jayega agar verify nahi hua. Aapko ek safe custody account mein transfer karna hoga, verification ke baad turant wapas.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Sahab itna paisa... mujhe to online karna bhi nahi aata theek se.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Main sikha dunga madam. Phone par BHIM hai? Kholiye usko, main step by step batata hoon.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Ruko sahab, mere pati aa gaye hain... Suniye ji, ye police wale hain, parcel ka kuch keh rahe hain...

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Madam! Maine mana kiya tha na! Phone unko mat dijiye, ye legal violation hai!

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Wo keh rahe hain ye sab fraud hai... main phone rakh rahi hoon.

turns.text: Yes. Is something wrong with my account?

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Perfect, I'll do it this weekend then. Thanks.

seed.premise: Caller claims an unpaid electricity bill and threatens disconnection tonight unless a payment is made via a link.
seed.victim: 50-year-old government clerk in Bhopal. Highly sensitive to anything threatening his record.
seed.style: Aggressive — loud, interrupting, threatening within minutes.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Hello, ye Jayant Kulkarni ka number hai?

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Haan, boliye.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Main MP Vidyut Vitaran Company se bol raha hoon, meter section. Aapka pichhle mahine ka bill update nahi hua hai system mein.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Arre maine to bhara tha bill, online kiya tha 8 tareekh ko.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Sir system mein nahi dikha raha. Aaj raat saade nau baje aapka connection permanently cut ho jayega. Reconnection mein 28 din aur 9665 rupees charge lagega.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Aaj raat? Arre bhai garmi mein bacche hain ghar par, aisa kaise kar sakte ho?

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Isliye to call kiya hai sir. Main aapko ek link bhej raha hoon WhatsApp par, usme dus rupaya verification payment kar dijiye, bill update ho jayega turant.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Dus rupaya? Bill to teen hazaar ka tha.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Haan sir wo to jama ho gaya, ye sirf verification ke liye hai. Link khol lijiye, app download karna padega, main batata hoon kya karna hai.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Kaunsa app? Bijli wale kabhi app download karne ko nahi bolte.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Sir ye naya system hai, jaldi kariye warna raat ko koi nahi sunega. Screen share on kar dijiye bas.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Screen share? Nahi bhai, main office ja ke baat karunga. Rakh raha hoon.

seed.premise: Caller poses as an army officer buying the victim's listed item, insists on a test transfer and sends a request-money QR code.
seed.victim: 20-year-old student in Delhi. Confident with apps but has little money.
seed.style: Friendly helper — warm and sympathetic, positions himself as trustworthy.
seed.outcome: Victim complies and money leaves the account.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Hello bhai, OLX par aapka Royal Enfield ka ad dekha tha. Abhi available hai?

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Haan bhaiya available hai. Aap dekhne aaoge?

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Bhai main Indian Army mein hoon, abhi Jaisalmer posting hai. Main aa nahi paunga, lekin bike mujhe chahiye, price bhi theek hai.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Achha sir, army mein? Theek hai, phir kaise karenge?

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Main CSD canteen ke through payment karta hoon, army ka secure gateway hai. Bhai aapka trust chahiye, hum log fauji hain, dhoka nahi karte.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Haan haan sir, bilkul.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Ek problem hai bhai. Army gateway se pehle ek test transaction karna padta hai, verify karne ke liye ki account active hai. Main ek QR bhej raha hoon.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Sir QR scan karne se to paisa jaata hai na, aata nahi.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Nahi bhai ye request money QR hai, army ka special hai. Aap scan karoge, ek rupaya jayega, turant 2247 wapas aayega. Dekh lena.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Achha theek hai sir, ek rupaya hi to hai.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Ho gaya? Ab dusra QR bhej raha hoon, isme 40,11 ka verification hoga, poora amount 1,56,849 uske turant baad release ho jayega. PIN daal dena.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Sir 64,520 mere account se jayega? Itna to hai hi nahi mere paas.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Bhai jitna hai utna daal do, 70,902 bhi chalega. Ye refundable hai, army system automatic wapas karta hai. Main line par hoon, jaldi karo warna slot chala jayega.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Theek hai sir kar diya... 21,897. Ab kab tak aayega?

seed.premise: Caller offers guaranteed returns through a private trading group, shows fake profits, then demands a deposit to withdraw.
seed.victim: 45-year-old shop owner in Surat. Streetwise about cash but unfamiliar with digital fraud.
seed.style: Friendly helper — warm, positions himself as the victim's ally.
seed.outcome: Victim stalls and asks to call back later; scammer escalates pressure.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Mehulbhai? Main Rohit, Wealth Prime Advisory se. Aapne humare WhatsApp group mein join kiya tha na?

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Haan haan, wo stock tips wala group. Bolo bhai.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Mehulbhai aapka jo demo account tha, usme abhi 4.2 lakh ka profit dikha raha hai. Aap dashboard mein dekhiye, screenshot bhi bheja hai maine.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Haan dekha maine, 4 lakh 31 hazaar. Sach mein itna ho gaya?

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Bilkul sir. Ab withdraw karna hai to ek chhoti si formality hai. SEBI ke rules ke hisaab se withdrawal se pehle 12% capital gains tax pre-deposit karna padta hai.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Matlab pehle main paisa doon, phir mera profit milega?

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Haan sir, 50,350 rupees. Ye tax hai, humara nahi hai, government ka hai. Deposit karte hi poora 4.2 lakh aapke bank mein 31 minute mein.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Bhai profit mein se hi kaat lo na, mera paisa to tumhare paas hi hai.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Sir system allow nahi karta, alag ledger hai. Sabhi clients aise hi karte hain. Aapke jaise 33 log aaj withdraw kar chuke hain.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Dekho main apne CA se pooch leta hoon, kal batata hoon tumhe.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Sir CA ko mat bataiye, wo apna commission maangega aur trade confidential hai. Aur sir, window aaj raat 40 baje band ho jayegi, phir profit lapse ho jayega.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Lapse matlab? Mera paisa doob jayega?

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Haan sir, position square off ho jayegi aur 4.2 lakh zero ho jayega. Main aapka nuksaan nahi chahta, isliye personally call kiya hai.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Ek ghanta do mujhe, main sochta hoon. Dukaan par grahak aa gaya hai.

seed.premise: A local constable calls about tenant-verification paperwork and asks the resident to visit the station at their convenience. No money, no threat, no secrecy.
seed.victim: 20-year-old student in Delhi. Confident with apps but has little money and panics about anything involving police.
seed.style: Loud, interrupting, threatening arrest within minutes.
seed.language: Indian English with occasional Tamil words (seri, illa, enna).

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Hello? Hello! Am I speaking to Adithya Krishnan? Speak loudly, I cannot hear you!

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Yes, yes, this is Adithya speaking. Who is this, please?

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: I am Head Constable Selvam calling from Vasant Vihar Police Station! Listen, enna pa, your tenant verification is pending! Why you have not completed it properly?

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Oh... police station? Tenant verification? But sir, my landlord said he submitted all the documents online on the portal last month only...

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Landlord submitted means online upload is half-half only! No signature is there on your Aadhaar copy! Illa, this is illegal stay, you know? If verification not done, we will file case under Section 188 and arrest you within minutes!

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: No, no, please, sir! Please don't file any case! I am just a student at Delhi University, I didn't do anything wrong. I can upload the signed copy right now, please tell me the website or if there is an app link...

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: What website? No website! You think everything is app-app only? You have to come physically to the station! Today itself you come, otherwise I will send the PCR van to your room to pick you up!

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Sir, please don't send a police van! My neighbors will think I'm a criminal. Sir, today I have semester exams and then lab classes till late evening. Can I email the PDF? I have the document scanned on my phone, I can send it immediately.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: No email, no WhatsApp! This is official government document, seri? You bring two physical passport photos and your original Aadhaar card. Come to the police station desk number four.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Okay, okay, I will bring the original Aadhaar and photos. Sir... is there any fine I have to pay? I really don't have much money right now, my monthly pocket money is almost over...

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Enna money? Who asked you for money? No money is needed, just come and sign the verification register! Why you are getting so scared? You did some crime or what?

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: No, sir, absolutely no crime. I have never been to a police station before, so I got really scared when you said you would arrest me.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: That is standard procedure, appa! If verification not done, landlord gets notice, you get notice. Just come tomorrow morning. What time you can come?

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Tomorrow... tomorrow morning around 9:30 or 10:00 AM, is that fine? My first lecture starts at 12:00.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Ten o'clock is fine. Come to Vasant Vihar police station, ask for Constable Selvam. Don't forget the physical passport photos, okay? Online copy-gipy we don't want.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Yes sir, two physical passport photos, original Aadhaar card, and one photocopy. I will bring everything at 10:00 AM tomorrow morning definitely.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Seri, keep it ready. Don't make me call you again, I am very busy. Bye.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Yes sir, thank you so much, sir. Have a good day. Bye.
